name: fsh-sushi
note: FHIR Shorthand (FSH) SUSHI compiler 3.21.0 published npm tarball, executed with its declared `node@22.23.4` runtime injected onto `PATH`. The digest was computed over the downloaded tarball (416,566 bytes) on 2026-10-30; the same bytes match the registry's own `dist.integrity` (sha512) and `dist.shasum` (sha1). The licence is Apache-2.0, not MIT: it was Apache-2.0 at 3.13.0 too, and the earlier record said MIT in error.
